How To Install FIFA 16 Mod FIFA 2026 Apk Obb Data Files

Below are the steps to install, extract and set up FIFA 2026 Mod FIFA 16 Apk Obb Data files, the steps is also divided into sections.

Section 1: How To Extract Data File For FIFA 16 Mod 26 

  1. Using installed Zarchiver App, locate data FIFA 2026 Mod 16 Zip file click on it.
  2. Options menu will come up, then click “Extract Here”, and wait for the data file to be fully extracted in current folder.
  3. After that, click and hold on the extracted  Data File “com.ea.gp.fifaworld”.
  4. options menu will come up, then “click Copy”.
  5. At the top of Zarchiver App interface click on “0/storage/emulated” and continue to step 5.
  6. A drop down menu will appear then click “Device Storage ” .
  7. Click “Android folder” and continue.
  8. Now click “Data folder” and wait there.
  9. Finally click “Paste icon”, just like in the image below.

 

Section 2: How To extract Obb file for FIFA 16 Mod 26

  1. Using installed Zarchiver App, locate the Obb FIFA 16 Mod Rar or Zip file and click on it.
  2. Options menu will come up just click “Extract”.
  3. Click 0/storage/emulated at the top of Zarchiver App interface.
  4. From the drop down menu that appears, click “Device Storage”.
  5. Now Click Android folder.
  6. Then click “Obb folder” and wait there
  7. Click “Extract icon” that looks like arrow pointing downwards to begin obb file extraction.
